text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone doing all right? No sizing issues
or anything?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, just a minute, please! Can't... tie
the sash!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Urara! Stay still for just a
little longer! We're almost
done!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haah ha ha ha! Gaze upon me, robed in
splendor! Such beauty cannot
be of this
realm—I am as a rose sent from heaven
itself!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My very person is a cause for celebration,
a herald of the new year!
Witness! For I
hereby declare the founding of the New
Overlord
Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm all dressed up too! Oh hey, mine's
different from Oppy's!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Given the special occasion, I
thought I'd ask the designer to
tailor the
pieces to match each of you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's our Tazuna! Always paying attention
to detail! Now, how fare
the other two?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And here I am! The size, the fit, it's just
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the fortune coming already!
Auspicious and ostentatious! I
think I could
take a 3,000-meter over turf with ease!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Director? It's so gorgeous, I can't
help but feel like it's wasted
on me...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! When our students challenge
their limits, it is our duty to
support them
in any way we can!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Karuta may seem like an elegant game,
but in truth it is fierce! Proper
dress
requires the same material used in
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As you will be representing our academy,
we want you competing at
full strength!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: D-Director... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure the old me would've felt nothing
but pressure hearing those
words... but
now...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Basically, a taker needs acceleration, fast
reflexes, the ability to
make snap
judgments, and speed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, um... since you excel in the final leg of
a race, I think you would
be best for the
role.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it? When you suddenly requested a
change of command, I
thought you were
planning a rebellious takeover scene!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what? I-I would never do that!
A-also, I was thinking about
you two,
and...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In karuta, you also need someone to
"guard" and "screen"—get in the

opponent's way, basically.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You guard the card when it's on your side,
and when it's on their side,
you set a
screen so your teammate has a clear path
to it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-so I was thinking, Fukukitaru, you could
focus on the opponent and
tell Urara how
to move accordingly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. My voice is louder, and
I bet Urara would stick to
her mark like
glue!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And if that slows down our opponents
even a little, Opera O can
make a run for
it—and sh-she'd never lose!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, erm, sorry, I know coming from me it...
i-it might sound stupid,
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! Who knew karuta had so
much strategic depth to
it—color me
surprised!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm starting to get excited!
Okay then, let's swap roles and
give it a
go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's the matter, Doto? Something
on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! I-it's just, wearing these robes
suddenly makes the tournament
feel so
much more real...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I think you're right! Before a race, it's
once you put on your
racewear that the
nerves really start to kick in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left for us to do is put your
strategy to the test.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey folks, really appreciate you lending us
a hand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mention it. You guys are gonna
compete in the tournament,
right? That's
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: We're all rooting for ya—you guys got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aw, well thank you. Okay, so, when the
poem starts, if you could run
over to this
side of the field...

text_block_list.name: Reciter App
text_block_list.text: Umamusume, eternal...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O! Our side, left, five-one!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Already there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara, time to guard! Spread out your arms
and don't let them past!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! Just like this!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aha! Mine for the taking!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uhh... um, did we just...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A truly ideal, truly elegant performance!
Perfect, I might even venture
to call it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! My guard was perfect too,
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know, I had my doubts at first, but we
absolutely crushed it. I
don't think it gets
any better than that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks to Doto studying up on
karuta for us. Isn't that
right, "Commander"
Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeep! I-I didn't do that much! B-but, if I
helped even a little bit,
th-then I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We worked super hard, so I know we're
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(She's not wrong... Practice is going well,
so maybe, just maybe... I
thought it'd be
totally out of our reach, but...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-well, there are no guarantees! But win
or lose, let's go into it ready
to grab
ourselves a bag of New Year's fortune!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
